rounds.text: The market is currently under-appreciating a significant pivot in the company’s operational efficiency and bottom-line trajectory. While long-term sales growth has been challenged [E7], the company has successfully expanded its operating margin to 9% in March 2026, representing a 3 percentage point improvement over three years [E18]. This structural improvement is yielding tangible results, evidenced by a 50% growth in compounded profit over the trailing twelve months [E14], which notably outperforms the sector median profit growth of 11.2% [E54]. Furthermore, the company has demonstrated an accelerating trend in profitability, with 5-year compounded profit growth of 15% [E12] signaling a recovery from earlier stagnation. The stock’s current position at the top of its 52-week range [E5] reflects growing investor recognition of this momentum. Conceded: [E1], [E4], [E6], [E7], [E13], [E19], [E42].

The bull leans heavily on trailing profit momentum [E14] and a 5-year profit growth recovery [E12], but these figures completely mask a severe recent collapse in medium-term earnings, where compounded profit growth over the last 3 years has crashed by -47% [E13]. While the bull highlights operating margin expansion over a three-year span [E18], it ignores the immediate contraction seen in quarterly figures, where operating margins dropped 3 percentage points to 15% in Mar 2026 compared to the year-ago quarter [E19]. Conceded: [E14]. Furthermore, the bull cites the stock sitting at 100% of its 52-week range [E5] as validation of momentum, whereas the signal engine explicitly warns that price growth is outpacing profit growth by 7%, meaning expectations are dangerously running ahead of actual delivery [E42]. Long-term top-line erosion remains a chronic structural anchor with a 10-year compounded sales decline of -13% [E7], paired with a lackluster 7% ROCE [E6] that thoroughly invalidates any narrative of high-quality capital compounding.
